exposure: maternal indication for oocyte donation (intra-couple IVF failure, genetic cause, idiopathic POI, iatrogenic POI)
cohort: Infertile women aged 18 to 43 years undergoing oocyte donation between 2012 and 2024.
finding: Patients with idiopathic POI achieve better pregnancy and live birth rates after oocyte donation, without a specific increase in obstetric complications compared with other indications.
mod_finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 44%.
